report.summary: Patient P-D006 (59, uninsured, no transport benefit) needs transport options for an upcoming primary care appointment (appt:2, 2026-10-23 14:00 at Clinic). Screener reports no transportation problem; patient mentioned the Pulaski bus serves the area. Home tract has 36 transit stops within 800m. Transit feasibility to the facility could not be verified (no location on file). Four directory options were reviewed: RideWell Medical Transport (hours Mon-Fri 8am-4pm, could fit a 2pm visit; eligibility not publicly verifiable), Medicaid Ride Line (Medicaid members only — patient uninsured, not eligible), Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit, ~21-day decision, eligibility uncertain), Senior Shuttle West (ages 60+ — patient is 59, not eligible by age).

options.name: RideWell Medical Transport
options.how_to_access: Medical transport program, hours Mon-Fri 8 AM-4 PM. Eligibility not verifiable from public page; contact program directly to confirm the uninsured patient qualifies and to schedule.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: For Medicaid plan members; call number on card at least 2 business days ahead. Patient is uninsured, so not eligible.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days. Eligibility depends on ADA qualification (not confirmed).

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free rides for adults 60+ to medical appointments, weekdays 7 AM-5 PM. Patient is 59, so not eligible by age cutoff.
